package cli

import (
	"fmt"
	posemodel "github.com/harne8/pose-mcp/internal/pose"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestB38R2PreparedSource(t *testing.T) {
	root := cliReleaseRepo(t)
	p := posemodel.ReleasePolicy{SchemaVersion: 1, VersionSource: &posemodel.ReleaseVersionSource{Path: "VERSION", Kind: "text"}}
	writeCloseoutCLIFile(t, root, ".pose/policy/release.json", string(posemodel.CanonicalJSON(p)))
	m, e := posemodel.LoadReleaseManifest(root, "v1.0.0")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	m2 := posemodel.NewReleaseManifest(m.Version, m.PreviousVersion, m.PreparedAt, m.Fragments, p, posemodel.ChangelogPolicy{}, map[string]string{"source": "missing.txt", "kind": "text", "value": m.Version})
	writeCloseoutCLIFile(t, root, ".pose/releases/v1.0.0/manifest.json", string(posemodel.CanonicalJSON(m2)))
	g, _ := checkRelease(root, "v1.0.0")
	t.Logf("missing version source gaps=%v", g)
	if len(g) != 0 {
		t.Error("probe changed")
	}
}
func TestB38R2StatusVsCheck(t *testing.T) {
	root := cliReleaseRepo(t)
	relGitCLI(t, root, "tag", "v1.0.0")
	os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, ".pose/changelogs/v1.0.0.md"))
	g, _ := checkRelease(root, "v1.0.0")
	s, e := (posemodel.Store{Root: root}).GetReleaseStatus("")
	t.Logf("check gaps=%v status sound=%v error=%v", g, s.Releases[0].Sound(), e)
}
func TestB38R2GitResolutionFailure(t *testing.T) {
	root := cliReleaseRepo(t)
	relGitCLI(t, root, "tag", "v1.0.0")
	real, _ := exec.LookPath("git")
	bin := t.TempDir()
	script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\ncase \"$*\" in *'cat-file -t refs/tags/'*) echo injected_failure >&2;exit 1;;esac\nexec %q \"$@\"\n", real)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(bin, "git"), []byte(script), 0755)
	t.Setenv("PATH", bin+":"+os.Getenv("PATH"))
	_, _, e := posemodel.ResolveReleaseTag(root, "v1.0.0")
	g, tag := releaseTagState(root, "v1.0.0")
	t.Logf("resolution=%v tag=%v gaps=%v", e, tag, g)
}
func TestB38R2GlobalPendingAndLocalRelease(t *testing.T) {
	root := cliReleaseRepo(t)
	writeCloseoutCLIFile(t, root, ".pose/policy/release.json", `{"schema_version":1,"adopted_at":"2026-01-01","provider":"github","repository":"o/r"}`)
	writeCloseoutCLIFile(t, root, ".pose/changelogs/unreleased/bad.md", "not a fragment")
	code, out := runPose(t, root, "check", "--strict")
	t.Logf("global code=%d release diagnostics=%v", code, strings.Contains(out, "release:"))
	t.Log(out)
	g, _ := checkRelease(root, "v1.0.0")
	t.Logf("specific gaps=%v", g)
}
func TestB38R2HumanLimits(t *testing.T) {
	root := cliReleaseRepoKind(t, "json")
	relGitCLI(t, root, "tag", "v1.0.0")
	code, out := runPose(t, root, "release", "status")
	t.Logf("status code=%d output=%q", code, out)
	code, out = runPose(t, root, "release", "check", "--version", "v1.0.0")
	t.Logf("check code=%d output=%q", code, out)
}
func TestB38R2PrepareInvalidExisting(t *testing.T) {
	root := cliReleaseRepo(t)
	p := posemodel.ReleasePolicy{SchemaVersion: 1, AdoptedAt: "2026-01-01", Provider: "github", Repository: "o/r", AllowEmpty: true, VersionSource: &posemodel.ReleaseVersionSource{Path: "VERSION", Kind: "text"}}
	writeCloseoutCLIFile(t, root, ".pose/policy/release.json", string(posemodel.CanonicalJSON(p)))
	os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(root, ".pose/changelogs/v1.0.0"))
	m := posemodel.NewReleaseManifest("v1.0.0", "", "2026-10-02T00:00:00Z", nil, p, posemodel.ChangelogPolicy{}, map[string]string{"source": "VERSION", "kind": "text", "value": "v1.0.0"})
	bad := strings.Replace(string(posemodel.CanonicalJSON(m)), `"breaking": false,`, "", 1)
	writeCloseoutCLIFile(t, root, ".pose/releases/v1.0.0/manifest.json", bad)
	code, out := runPose(t, root, "release", "prepare", "--version", "v1.0.0", "--apply")
	after, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".pose/releases/v1.0.0/manifest.json"))
	t.Logf("prepare code=%d overwrote=%v output=%q", code, string(after) != bad, out)
}
